# ui.tabs drawn as each desktop and terminal target draws tabs, where the three
# drew sngl:ui's row of buttons: gtk4 a GtkStackSwitcher over a GtkStack, fyne
# an AppTabs, bubbletea a lipgloss tab bar over a box the bar opens onto.
# testdata/tabs_look.txtar is the code.
#
# A test still switches tabs by pressing one, `c.tabs.change(1)`: the press
# finds the page each tab is, whose handler emits the change. Writing
# `selected` shows the same panel and fires no @change, though GTK and Fyne
# report every change of the shown page, the program's own too. A tab an `if`
# adds is a page of the stack and of the AppTabs, and goes when it turns
# false.
#
# bubbletea's bar is boxes along the top, the selected one open at the bottom
# onto its panel and the rest closed, with the line carried on to the panel's
# right edge; `> ` is the focused tab, as it is a focused button. `pills` draws
# no boxes: the selected label is reversed, which the text snapshot does not
# show and pkg/go/tui's TestTabLookPills does.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   4 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   4 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/second.png
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/second.png app.sngl.snapshots/written.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/without.png app.sngl.snapshots/with.png
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/without.png app.sngl.snapshots/gone.png

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   4 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/second.png
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/second.png app.sngl.snapshots/written.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/without.png app.sngl.snapshots/with.png
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/without.png app.sngl.snapshots/gone.png

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   4 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component strip ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var changed = -1

    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=idx, @change(i) {
        changed = i
    }) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="first panel")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            ui.text(value="second panel")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Off", disabled=true) {
            ui.text(value="third panel")
        }
    }
}

component grows ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var extra = false

    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=idx) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="first panel")
        }
        if extra {
            ui.tab(label="More") {
                ui.text(value="more panel")
            }
        }
    }
}

component pills ui.node {
    var idx = 0

    ui.tabs(:selected=idx, variant=ui.TabsVariant.pills) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="first panel")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            ui.text(value="second panel")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Off", disabled=true) {
            ui.text(value="third panel")
        }
    }
}

func testPressingATabShowsItsPanel(t test.Test, c strip) {
    t.snapshot("first")
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.idx == 1)
    t.assert(c.changed == 1)
    t.snapshot("second")
}

func testWritingSelectedFiresNoChange(t test.Test, c strip) {
    c.idx = 1
    t.assert(c.changed == -1)
    t.snapshot("written")
}

func testATabAnIfAddsComesAndGoes(t test.Test, c grows) {
    t.snapshot("without")
    c.extra = true
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.idx == 1)
    t.snapshot("with")
    c.idx = 0
    c.extra = false
    t.snapshot("gone")
}

func testPills(t test.Test, c pills) {
    t.snapshot("pills")
}

ui.window(title="Tabs") {
    strip
}

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
}
